idea.title: LocalLens — Privacy-first web scraper with local LLM analysis

plan.tagline: Privacy-first CLI web scraper with local LLM analysis
plan.problem: Developers and small businesses need to extract and analyze web data without sending sensitive info to third-party APIs or cloud services.
plan.solution: Scrapes websites locally, stores data in SQLite, and analyzes it with a local LLM (no internet required). Runs entirely offline with optional cloud sync for backups.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses needing automated web data extraction and analysis without privacy risks or API costs.
mvp_features: CLI-based web scraping with URL input
Local SQLite storage for scraped data

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for storing scrapes + add/list commands

plan.demo_script: Run `python local_lens.py --demo` to see a mock scrape of 'example.com' with local LLM analysis (offline). Outputs a CSV report and summary.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses (e.g., tour operators, real estate) can scrape local listings or competitor sites offline, avoiding API fees and privacy concerns.
